title: Buildroot Card DB — snapshots, PhaseNav, GGUF, ResEnta RT
epistemic_status: bridge_card; deterministic Buildroot snapshot registry with optional GGUF translation

meaning.summary: Bridge card for a dedicated Buildroot card database. It exposes the generated subregistry, the Buildroot probe, and the RT-oriented slices used by NOEMA.
meaning.boundary: Read-only DB bridge. The Buildroot tree itself remains external; NOEMA keeps only the generated card surface and probes.
meaning.why: Having Buildroot cards as first-class NOEMA artifacts makes ResEnta RT implementation much easier to reason about and test.

index_policy.metadata_for: Buildroot directories, menu tree, package graph and probe/benchmark slices
index_policy.fallback: Deterministic probe output if GGUF is absent
